No spam, just updates about Desktop Pet. How to Use Desktop Pet Get started with your new AI-powered desktop companion! Set Up OpenAI API Key Go to OpenAI API Keys Sign up or log in to your OpenAI account Create a new API key Right-click on your desktop pet Select "Set OpenAI API Key..." from the menu Enter your API key and click OK Your API key is stored locally and never shared with us. Basic Controls Right-click: Open the pet menu Double-click: Interact with your pet Click and drag: Move your pet around the screen Press Tab: Place the pet at the desired spot Assistant Mode: Right-click → "Assistant Mode" for AI chat Voice Commands Enable wake word detection in Voice Settings Say your wake word (default: "Hey Pet") Speak your request clearly Try commands like: "What's the weather in Miami?" "Set a timer for 30 minutes" "Remind me to call mom at 3pm" Settings & Customization Volume Control: Mute, Low, Medium, High Font Size: Small, Medium, Large Time Format: 12-hour or 24-hour Timezone: Choose your local timezone Wake Word: Customize voice activation phrase Privacy & Security We do NOT collect, store, or send any data to external servers All settings and preferences are stored locally Your conversations are not saved permanently No personal information is collected or tracked Troubleshooting App won't start: Check antivirus settings, allow in security preferences AI chat not working: Verify OpenAI API key and internet connection Voice commands not working: Check microphone permissions Weather not working: Check internet connection Need Help?
